does: Enters a status on its owner: marks it entered, lets statuses it replaces exit, raises the applied status event (0x10) - where the status's OnApplyRoll is evaluated - and then applies the prototype's settings.

evidence.says: the macOS build's symbols hold this name and EoCServer.dll exports it, a virtual of the server's status; this function calls esv::Status::IsOnSourceSurface and GetStatusMachine and is called by esv::StatusBoost::Enter and esv::StatusKnockedDown::Enter, as a base class's Enter is
a probe during Osi.ApplyStatus of HOLD_PERSON shows 1 call from esv::StatusBoost::Enter; See Invisibility's save chain passes it
EoCServer.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
